snippet.title: Cavaleiros Celestiais | Alpha Trailer | Free Dark Fantasy MMORPG
snippet.description:
The first trailer for Cavaleiros Celestiais, recorded in the game the way it is today, in alpha. A whole world in 3D, twelve regions, seven Houses with different ways to fight, mounts, colossi and world bosses nobody takes down alone. And when the fight is over, the party starts.

The alpha is open and the game is free on PC: get the launcher at https://cconline.com.br/en/, create your account and pick your House.

#mmorpg #cavaleiroscelestiais #indiegame #gamedev

Play for free: https://cconline.com.br/en/
Subscribe to the channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCDv0FKIOnBwKMSS4UtiVx6w?sub_confirmation=1
